text:
liam: kickoff: we need a deprecation scenario matrix for models that diverge after quant/opt changes. goal: codify decisions so CS/ops can act without engineering triage for every case.
maya: I sketched a matrix: axis X = technical delta (low/med/high), axis Y = business impact (low/med/high). each cell -> recommended path: self-serve migrate, CSM-assisted, blocked + eng review.
nate: can we add column for pinning semantics? e.g., if tenant has pin=semver:major then migration requires opt-in; if pin=none or pin=latest, auto-migrate per policy. make it explicit in the matrix.
oliver: ops constraints: fallback routing must preserve API surface. proposal: when we retire backend A, create alias A -> B for a 90d soft-alias period, with metric watchlist. allow customers to set pin_override=true to keep old backend until explicit unpin.
payal: benchmarks to include: p95 latency, sample embedding shift (mean cosine), hallucination false-positive rate on a curated set, and a token-cost delta. each metric gets a band: green/amber/red with numeric thresholds.
liam: add customer-impact override: even if technical risk = green, if customer SLA == enterprise and monthly spend > $50k, default to CSM-assisted. we need a business-risk override column.
maya: rollout policy: for green cells -> 14d advisory + 7d reminder + self-serve migrate button; for amber -> 45d advisory + simulated preview + CSM outreach; red -> block and open eng ticket.
nate: technical canaries: parametrize by tenant qps. small tenants: 5% traffic for 48h. medium: 2% for 7d. large: bespoke, but start with mirrored replay, not live routing, until approved.
oliver: infra bits: new model-catalog flags: deprecation_state (enum: staging, soft_deprecate, deprecated), alias_target, pin_override_allowed (bool). telemetry: attach deprecation_id to all requests for 30d after aliasing so we can compare cohorts.
payal: define rollback probes: automated checks that run at 1h, 24h, 7d post-migration: alert if p95 latency +20% or embed-sim mean drops below amber or error_rate +2%. rollback window defaults to 7d for self-serve, 14d for CSM-assisted.
liam: comms templates: 1) advisory email, 2) migration preview link (one-click), 3) post-migration watch summary. draft CTAs: "Preview impact", "Schedule CSM assist", "Stay pinned". embed estimated credit if offered.
maya: credits policy: auto-credit when business_impact = low AND technical_delta <= low AND tenant_monthly_spend < $10k. credit amount = min(tenant_spend, $500). all other credits require manual approval. log credit_grant_id and reason.
nate: API changes: /models/:id metadata includes deprecation_state, alias_target, migration_grace_days. /tenants/:id supports pin_override and migration_preference (auto|cs_assist|manual). return migration_plan_url when sim run.
oliver: telemetry storage: keep comparison snapshots for 60d; store only hashed inputs + normalized outputs (PII-scrubbed). simulator jobs should be rate-limited per-tenant.
payal: golden prompts: curate three tiers: common prompts, edge-case prompts, function-call prompts. ownership: maya for common, nate for function calls, liam for edge cases. periodically refresh with tenant samples.
liam: decision log: default policy = auto-migrate for new non-enterprise tenants unless they opt-out. enterprise get CSM reach-out by default. legal: need a short opt-out clause in TOS for credits.
maya: ops-runbook sketch: 1) run simulator/report 2) if green -> schedule auto-migrate after 21d notice 3) execute canary per tenant size 4) run rollback probes 5) confirm and close ticket. include fast-unwind steps.
nate: rollout plan: week1 infra flags + schemas, week2 simulator alpha, week3 UI preview + templates, week4 beta with 25 tenants, week6 full launch. owners: liam (policy), maya (benchmarks+comm), nate (runtime), oliver (infra), payal (SLOs/alerts).
ops-bot: deployment note: branch deprecation-matrix queued; model-catalog v3.1 schema changes pending migration_review.
liam: meeting: Friday 2pm to finalize numeric thresholds and publish ops-runbook. :spiral_calendar_pad:
